title: Tavern 0.6.185: Java Mead feedback and current source contracts
native_evidence_scope: Current source behavior and Java resource contracts cover maintained extension ownership and Mead quality feedback. Canonical CI, complete-family clean-world initialization/persistence and rendered-client acceptance retain their separate scope. Family runtime identities are selected by family/upstream.lock.json and exact peer commits by canonical validation.
public_notes_inline: Support the current stable Sculk and Dimensions Wine protocol, shared guide groups and native light/Mead interactions. Mead Essence now shows only the source-backed green quality-up message. Current behavior and Java resource contracts own these modules; superseded source-shape projections are retired. Complete-family fresh-world and rendered-client acceptance remain separate pending gates.
